metadata.description: Offline/live-shadow preparation for applying the validated closed-loop global-path pipeline to accepted T_map_lidar pose feedback.
metadata.stage: Real Global Path Tracking V1 — SHADOW ONLY
metadata.calibration_status: All real-runtime numerical limits are INITIAL SAFETY CAP / NOT CALIBRATED. No real motion performance is claimed.

runtime.phase_1_planar_feedback: Use localization x/y and quaternion yaw as planar feedback because the current LiDAR/base XY centers and axes are aligned for this experiment; exact T_base_lidar remains unresolved.
runtime.execution_semantics: Alignment and instantaneous command-candidate evaluation only. A physical trajectory clock, reference-progress execution, and lap execution are not implemented in Shadow V1 and remain a future Gate.

initial_safety_envelope_not_calibrated.rationale: The body/yaw/track caps are deliberately far below the validated simulation limits (0.60 m/s, 0.70 rad/s, 0.80 m/s). They limit a future first integration attempt but do not claim that 0.10 m/s overcomes the observed low-speed deadzone or that any value is calibrated.
initial_safety_envelope_not_calibrated.unsafe_candidate_policy: Any missing, stale, wrong-frame, non-finite, invalid-quaternion, or excessive-jump localization forces the hypothetical real-safe candidate to zero.

startup_alignment.policy: Diagnostics only: report canonical-start XY/heading error and nearest closed-path progress/error. Do not infer armability.

future_command_timeout_watchdog.future_semantics: A future publisher must command zero after timeout, localization loss, exception, Ctrl+C, or shutdown.

required_guards: localization loss or process shutdown produces zero

recorded_audit.source: accepted Bag D T_map_lidar trajectory from dataset provenance config
recorded_audit.interpretation: Interface, convention, projection, and safety-clamp audit only. Bag D did not follow rounded_loop, so its errors are not tracking-performance metrics.

row_source_semantics.POSE_UPDATE: Rows generated directly by a /localization/pose callback. Future tracking-performance metrics must use only these rows.
row_source_semantics.STATUS_TIMER: Periodic status/watchdog evaluation rows. Preserve for safety and freshness analysis; exclude from tracking-performance weighting.
row_source_semantics.RECORDED_POSE: Rows generated by accepted Bag-D offline replay. Preserve for interface/safety audit; never interpret as rounded-loop tracking performance.
